question: Who moved the resolution proposing that the National Flag of India be a ‘horizontal tricolour of saffron, white and dark green in equal proportion’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jawaharlal Nehru**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Jawaharlal Nehru** moved the resolution proposing that the National Flag of India be a 'horizontal tricolour of saffron, white and dark green in equal proportion'.
 
• This resolution was moved on **22nd July 1947** and was adopted by the Constituent Assembly of India.
